description: This file defines the 'Style' class as part of the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, representing style templates for paragraph or character formatting within the document object model. It includes constructors, properties, methods for cloning, serialization, and managing style inheritance.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Represents style templates for paragraph or character formatting, supporting inheritance, cloning, and serialization within the document model.

methods.name: Style()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the style object.

methods.name: Style(string name, string? baseStyleName)
methods.description: Constructor creating a style with specified name and optional base style.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the style instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy()
methods.description: Performs the actual deep copy operation, including cloning ParagraphFormat if present.

methods.name: GetValue(string name, GV flags)
methods.description: Returns the value associated with a property name, with specific handling for font-related properties.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the style object into a textual representation, supporting built-in and user-defined styles.

methods.name: GetBaseStyle()
methods.description: Retrieves the base style of the current style, if applicable.
